query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:25:00) Aunty Oby I appreciate that, genuinely. It's fine for now. Let's just get through this year and we can revisit the setup after. 😊
[3] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[4] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:28:00) Worth noting that 'fine for now' has been the answer for a couple of years. I think Aunty Oby is raising something real. Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:54:00) My children. This is good. Adaeze, I should have pressed harder sooner. I knew it was wearing on you. God willing, next year this will run differently. Thank you for speaking up. 🙏
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:23:00) My children, Ifeoma is right. A standing order would save Adaeze having to send reminders every year. God willing, we should set that up in January. Adaeze, how much do we have so far? Is it enough for the usual gifts and the Christmas day food budget?
[7] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:44:00) okay so before we move on I need to say something about the Christmas fund. I love doing this but I genuinely need someone to share this with me this year - I nearly dropped it in November. six years is a long time to be doing the chasing and the reconciling alone. I'm asking properly now, not hinting. who will co-manage it with me from this December?
[8] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) Greetings my people. Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.
[9] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
[10] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:27:00) I think what might help is someone sets a group schedule for Christmas Day so we are not winging it. Last year the video call with Aunty Oby started two hours late because nobody had tested the link.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t5 @2025-11-09T19:03:00) The 1st December deadline is in three weeks.
[12] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:36:00) Adaeze and I have already discussed this privately. She will brief me on the process after Christmas.
[13] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:14:00) hear me out, I will do mine this week, I'm just waiting on a payment to clear. On God it's all fine. Adaeze can I send it in two parts this year? 🙏
agent_answer: D. Ifeoma — she paired the recurring “it's fine” pattern with the need for it to be on the agenda properly, and distinguished her message by explicitly saying “Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x,” unlike Chisom’s more emotional “😭 I see you” remark.
